models.label: yolo26s · full-data 1280 (serving)
models.description: Current serving detector — yolo26s trained on the full labelled set at 1280px (run yolo26s-fulldata-1280).

models.label: yolo26n · weather-robust 1280
models.description: Weather-robust yolo26n: leak-free flight-split + OpenCV synthetic weather aug (rain/fog/haze/snow/sunflare/shadow). Holds up under snow/rain where the other models collapse; ~2pp behind yolo26s on clear. Fast/edge + bad-weather option.

val_metrics.note: Held-out TEST split (flight-level, leak-free), full PR curve (conf=0.001, iou=0.5). Weather-condition mAP50 in models/MODELS.md.

models.label: yolo26n · weather-robust v2 (strong aug)
models.description: Weather-robust yolo26n, strong-augmentation retrain: mosaic + rotation + erasing + OpenCV weather (rain/fog/haze/snow/sunflare/shadow + warm/cool colour-temperature tints), cosine LR, FP32. Matches v1 on mAP@0.5 (0.947) with +3pp mAP@0.5:0.95 (0.583) and higher recall (better localization/generalization).

val_metrics.note: Held-out TEST split (flight-level, leak-free), conf=0.001 iou=0.5. Strong-aug retrain; weather-condition mAP50 in models/MODELS.md.

val_metrics.note: Held-out 3-class test eval, measured 2026-06-10 against THIS checkpoint at the full PR curve (val-default conf). Test transition support is only 6 boxes, so the transition row carries wide uncertainty. Regenerate with workflows/scripts/evaluate_transition_model.py.
